ex.en: Our school organised an environmental project to clean the river.
ex.zh: 我们学校组织了一项清理河流的环保活动。

ex.en: Governments should consider the environmental impact of new roads before approving major construction projects.
ex.zh: 政府在批准大型建设项目之前，应考虑新道路对环境的影响。

senses.zh: 自然环境的；生态环境的

ex.en: I packed my toothbrush in the side pocket.
ex.zh: 我把牙刷装进了侧面的口袋。

ex.en: Replacing a worn toothbrush regularly helps maintain oral hygiene by ensuring that teeth are cleaned effectively.
ex.zh: 定期更换磨损的牙刷有助于确保牙齿得到有效清洁，从而保持口腔卫生。

ex.en: I found my missing glove under the kitchen chair.
ex.zh: 我在厨房椅子下面找到了丢失的那只手套。

ex.en: Healthcare workers should change disposable gloves between patients to reduce the risk of spreading infections.
ex.zh: 医护人员在接诊不同患者之间应更换一次性手套，以降低传播感染的风险。

ex.en: My former neighbour still visits us every summer.
ex.zh: 我以前的邻居每年夏天仍会来看我们。

ex.en: Former industrial sites can be transformed into public parks, improving urban environments and creating shared spaces.
ex.zh: 昔日的工业用地可以改建为公园，从而改善城市环境并创造共享空间。

ex.en: The bird stretched its wings before leaving the branch.
ex.zh: 那只鸟飞离树枝前展开了翅膀。

ex.en: The hospital's new wing will provide additional beds and specialist facilities for the region's growing population.
ex.zh: 医院新建的侧楼将提供更多床位和专科设施，以服务该地区不断增长的人口。

senses.zh: 卡住的，无法移动的，动不了的

ex.en: Please put the banana skin in the kitchen bin.
ex.zh: 请把香蕉皮放进厨房的垃圾桶。

ex.en: Providing a separate bin for food waste can help households recycle more effectively and reduce landfill use.
ex.zh: 提供单独的厨余垃圾桶有助于家庭更有效地回收废物，并减少垃圾填埋量。

ex.en: A tiny frog jumped out of the flower pot.
ex.zh: 一只小小的青蛙从花盆里跳了出来。

ex.en: Even tiny changes in daily habits can reduce household energy consumption over time.
ex.zh: 即使日常习惯的微小改变，长期下来也能减少家庭能源消耗。

ex.en: We had trouble opening the stiff kitchen window.
ex.zh: 厨房的窗户很紧，我们费了好大劲才打开。

ex.en: Many older adults have trouble accessing public services that are available only through digital platforms.
ex.zh: 许多老年人难以使用那些仅通过数字平台提供的公共服务。

ex.en: The boat ride was the highlight of our holiday.
ex.zh: 乘船游览是我们假期中最精彩的部分。

ex.en: Recent studies highlight the importance of accessible green spaces for the physical and mental health of urban residents.
ex.zh: 近期研究强调，方便到达的绿地对城市居民的身心健康十分重要。

ex.en: Please don't pollute the stream by throwing rubbish into it.
ex.zh: 请不要往小溪里扔垃圾，污染溪水。

ex.en: Factories that pollute local rivers should face stricter penalties to protect ecosystems and public health.
ex.zh: 污染当地河流的工厂应受到更严厉的处罚，以保护生态系统和公众健康。

ex.en: Please switch off your electronic devices during the performance.
ex.zh: 演出期间请关闭电子设备。

ex.en: Electronic health records can help doctors share information efficiently, but strong safeguards are needed to protect patient privacy.
ex.zh: 电子健康档案能帮助医生高效共享信息，但必须采取有力措施保护患者隐私。

ex.en: A truck delivered fresh vegetables to the market this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早晨，一辆卡车把新鲜蔬菜送到了市场。

ex.en: Transporting goods by truck offers flexibility, but rail freight can reduce emissions over longer distances.
ex.zh: 用卡车运输货物较为灵活，但长途铁路货运能减少排放。

ex.en: The mechanic checked my car's emissions this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上，修理工检查了我汽车的尾气排放。

ex.en: Governments can reduce carbon emissions by investing in renewable energy and improving public transport networks.
ex.zh: 政府可以通过投资可再生能源和改善公共交通网络来减少碳排放。

ex.en: A fox slipped through the garden before sunrise.
ex.zh: 日出前，一只狐狸悄悄穿过花园。

ex.en: The red fox can adapt to urban environments where food is readily available from human activity.
ex.zh: 赤狐能够适应城市环境，因为人类活动使食物很容易获取。

ex.en: Everyone cheered loudly when our team won the match.
ex.zh: 我们队赢得比赛时，大家都大声欢呼。

ex.en: Passengers who speak loudly on public transport can disturb others, particularly during early morning or late evening journeys.
ex.zh: 在公共交通工具上大声说话的乘客会打扰他人，尤其是在清晨或深夜的行程中。

ex.en: Our village has a bakery beside the old bridge.
ex.zh: 我们村的老桥旁有一家面包店。

ex.en: Reliable public transport can help village residents access employment, education, and healthcare in nearby towns.
ex.zh: 可靠的公共交通可以帮助村民前往附近城镇就业、求学和就医。

ex.en: A reporter interviewed the coach after the match.
ex.zh: 比赛结束后，一名记者采访了教练。

ex.en: A responsible reporter checks information carefully before publishing stories that could influence public opinion on important social issues.
ex.zh: 负责任的记者在发表可能影响公众对重要社会问题看法的报道之前，会仔细核实信息。

ex.en: Check the depth before you jump into the pool.
ex.zh: 跳进泳池前先确认水深。

ex.en: University courses should encourage students to explore complex environmental issues in greater depth.
ex.zh: 大学课程应鼓励学生更深入地探讨复杂的环境问题。

ex.en: I suggest taking an umbrella because those clouds look dark.
ex.zh: 我建议带把伞，因为那些云看起来很阴沉。

ex.en: Recent studies suggest that access to green spaces can improve mental health among urban residents.
ex.zh: 近期研究表明，能够接触绿地可能有助于改善城市居民的心理健康。

ex.en: A local businessman opened a bakery near our school.
ex.zh: 一位当地商人在我们学校附近开了一家面包店。

ex.en: A successful businessman can support local development by investing in training and creating stable employment opportunities.
ex.zh: 成功的商人可以通过投资培训和创造稳定就业机会来支持当地发展。

ex.en: My uncle repairs industrial machines at a nearby factory.
ex.zh: 我叔叔在附近的一家工厂维修工业机器。

ex.en: Stricter controls on industrial waste can protect rivers and improve the health of nearby communities.
ex.zh: 加强对工业废物的管控可以保护河流，并改善附近社区居民的健康。

ex.en: I enjoy the peace of this garden before breakfast.
ex.zh: 我喜欢早餐前这座花园里的宁静。

ex.en: Lasting peace depends on cooperation between communities and fair access to essential resources.
ex.zh: 持久和平有赖于各群体之间的合作以及公平获取基本资源的机会。

ex.en: Our apartment building has a garden on the roof.
ex.zh: 我们住的公寓楼屋顶上有一个花园。

ex.en: Improving insulation in older buildings can reduce energy consumption and lower heating costs for residents.
ex.zh: 改善老旧建筑的隔热性能可以减少能源消耗，降低居民的取暖费用。
